title: Fourier coefficient of the complete quadratic function
statement: Let $n$ be even, and let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$. For the real sign-valued function obtained by encoding the complete quadratic form $\sum_{i<j}x_i x_j$ on $\mathbb F_2^n$, the absolute value of its Fourier coefficient indexed by the support of $\gamma$ is $2^{-n/2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $\gamma$ is a vector in the binary cube of dimension $n$
